meaning.R01: A new supplier must complete identity verification before its first purchase order.
meaning.R02: The Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not perform it.
meaning.R03: For a low-risk supplier, Compliance may request a site visit but is not obliged to request one.
meaning.R04: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review.
meaning.R05: A renewal for an existing supplier with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification.
meaning.R06: The renewal exemption does not apply when the supplier changes its legal name.
meaning.R07: A buyer must not activate a supplier flagged as blocked.
meaning.R08: A risk score of 70 or more is classified as high risk.
meaning.R09: Risk scores below 70 are classified as low risk.
meaning.R10: Approval expires 365 calendar days after its approval date.
meaning.R11: Changing a supplier bank account requires a new independent bank-account check before the next payment.
meaning.R12: Two supplier records may share a contact email address; the email address is not unique.

forbidden_inferences.text: Enhanced review is optional for high-risk suppliers.
A buyer may activate a blocked supplier.
A site visit is mandatory for every low-risk supplier.
A changed bank account can be used for the next payment without a new check.
A renewal after a legal-name change is exempt from identity verification.
A risk score of 69 is high risk.
Every supplier contact email is unique.
Every renewal with unchanged identity data requires repeat identity verification.
Supplier approval expires after 30 calendar days from approval.
A new supplier may receive its first order before identity verification.
A score equal to 70 is low risk.

source_scope: All 12 explicitly numbered synthetic rules. All are treated as critical controls in this internal replay; not a validated severity rubric.
